method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (ORCA 6.1.1, '! B3LYP D3BJ def2-SVP def2/J RIJCOSX', nproc=1)
model_reason: CPCM(water) whole-chain recompute was attempted but the O-protonated STARTING minima are not stationary points under CPCM (cI1 1 soft imag -44.9 cm-1; cI2 4 imag; cP 1 imag -89.8; cRC collapses to N-protonated oxime), so a CPCM dE#(TS-start minimum) is undefined. In gas phase the required starting minima (I1,I2,I4,P) are all 0-imag genuine minima, giving clean dE#. CPCM also does not fix the intrinsic O/N-protonation gap (gas +24 vs CPCM +21.8 kcal). Final = gas phase, consistent for all edges.
barrier_definition: dE# = E(TS) - E(that step's own starting minimum), pure electronic, kcal/mol

edges.note: BLOCKED. In gas phase the H3O+...oxime ion-dipole complex is NOT a minimum: it spontaneously transfers the proton to the oxime N (N-protonated oxime + water, RC2 = -364.117136 / RC3 = -364.121107, E1/rc/calc-459, calc-470). The OptTS for the O-protonation (job 531) did not converge (5 imaginary modes; E=-364.025636) because the declared start is itself a saddle. => E1 has no clean starting minimum in this model; reported null (fail-loud). ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE: job 531 (E1 OptTS) is a CONVERGED first-order saddle at -364.025644 (final VIBRATIONAL FREQUENCIES block: exactly 1 imaginary, -1791.63 cm-1; the 5-mode block at line 1764 is the INITIAL Hessian block, not the final one). BUT its geometry is an O->N proton-transfer saddle (oxime tautomerization: N4-H18 elongated 1.191 A, H12 migrating to the water O16 1.499 A), NOT the declared H3O+ -> oxime-O protonation. => this is further evidence that the O-protonated oxime cannot be stabilised in the gas phase (once O-protonated it immediately shuttles the proton to N). E1 remains null.

edges.type: dE-ddagger (concerted Beckmann: N-O cleavage + anti-1,2-ethyl migration)
edges.validation: saddle verified (OptTS converged, exactly 1 imaginary -304.17 cm-1). IRC run (job 539: fwd 50 frames / bwd 33). Outer-frame optimizations: forward frame -> nitrilium+2H2O (I2, -364.128, within 2.4 kcal); backward frame -> a distinct minimum at -364.055 (0 imag) that is ~17 kcal ABOVE I1, i.e. NOT I1. => connectivity only partially established; barrier value kept with caveat.
edges.note: TS2 E=-364.045333943017; dE# = E(TS2)-E(I1) = +23.13 kcal. Ethyl (anti to OH in the (E)-oxime) migrates; nitrilium CH3-C#N+-CH2CH3 + 2 H2O formed (I2). MODE/GEOMETRY CHECK: TS2 geometry has N5-O6 = 4.19 A (N-O fully cleaved), C2-N5 = 2.07 A (ethyl CH2 migrating to N), C3-N5 = 1.19 A (C=N/C#N forming), C2-C3 = 1.79 A (ethyl detaching from C) -- i.e. the -304.17 cm-1 mode is the concerted N-O cleavage + anti-1,2-ethyl migration (the Beckmann TS).
edges.irc_endpoint_note: E2 IRC does not cleanly return to I1 on one side (returns to a higher related minimum).

edges.type: merged E3+E4: nitrilium+2H2O -> neutral imidic acid + H3O+ (water attack on C + O->water proton transfer, concerted)
edges.note: MERGED-EDGE per coordinator. Reason: the gold intermediate I3 (O-protonated imidic acid + water, 'CCN=C(C)[OH2+].O') is NOT a minimum in this model. In gas phase it cleaves C-O to the nitrilium (C4-O 2.62 A, C4#N 1.155 A; E1/i3/calc-465); under CPCM(water) it transfers its O-proton to the spectator water -> I4 (CPCM job 509, 2 imaginary). The isolated O-protonated imidic acid cation IS a minimum (-287.786653, job 507), i.e. the spectator water is the base that removes the proton. Direct I2->I4 OptTS (job 530) did not converge (6 imaginary modes, E=-363.986095). => null (fail-loud).

SUBSUMED into the merged I2->I4 step (see HL1_E3). The gold node I3 (O-protonated imidic acid + water) is not a stationary minimum in this model (spectator water abstracts the O-proton), so E4 is not separable; recorded as subsumed/concurrent.

edges.frame: I4 = neutral imidic acid + H3O+, E=-364.187327366772 Ha
edges.note: DOWNGRADED to null. The OptTS job 529 converged (1 imaginary, -653.06 cm-1) but its final geometry is the AMIDE product + H3O+ (N3-H15=1.015 amide N-H; O6 is C=O with no H; O16 = H3O+ ~4.5 A from N3), and the -653.06 mode is an ISOLATED-PROTON soft mode (displacement essentially on one H only, no heavy-atom framework change) -- it is NOT the I4->P imidic-acid/amide tautomerisation saddle. The IRC also did not connect to P. => E5 = null + diagnostic.

cpcm_diagnostics.note: CPCM(water) single points / optimizations (diagnostic appendix, NOT used for barriers)

notes: Gold edges E2/E3/E5 literature values replaced by this campaign's computed values where available. E1 and E3/E4 could not be given clean values (see per-edge notes). Original gold mechanism assumed free O-protonated intermediates (I1,I3); in this model they are not stable minima (I3 does not exist; the H3O+...oxime complex collapses to N-protonation), which is why E1 and E4/E3(merged) are null/fail-loud.
irc_summary: Both E2 and E5 TSs are clean first-order saddles (1 imaginary each) with barriers 23.13 and 21.06 kcal/mol; IRC outer-frame endpoint optimizations do not fully return to both declared endpoints (partial for E2, inconclusive for E5). E1 and E3/E4 are null (fail-loud) as documented per edge.
remaining_gaps: HL1_E1 null: no clean starting minimum (H3O+...oxime collapses to N-protonation); the converged saddle from job 531 is an O->N PT saddle, not the E1 step.
HL1_E3 (merged E3+E4) null: gold I3 (O-protonated imidic acid + water) is not a minimum; I2->I4 OptTS non-converged.
HL1_E5 null: located saddle is an isolated-proton soft mode on the amide+H3O+ complex, not the tautomerisation TS; IRC not connected to P.
E2 IRC connectivity partial (one frame -> I2, other -> a related minimum, not I1).
final_status: HL1 (gas phase, B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, ORCA 6.1.1). VERIFIED: e2 = 23.13 kcal/mol (true TS, 1 imaginary -304.17, Beckmann N-O cleavage + anti-1,2-ethyl migration). e1 = 0 (barrierless). UNRESOLVED (no first-order saddle located after exhaustive routes, scan maxima not used as barriers): e3 (merged E3+E4) and e5. e4 subsumed.

corrected_mechanism_graph.note: Rewritten around the PES minima that actually exist in this gas-phase model (B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP). Gold's free O-protonated intermediates are not all stationary points.

properties.note: Real minimum at the reactant end = N-protonated oxime + water (E1/rc/calc-470). The declared H3O+...oxime(O) ion-dipole complex is NOT a minimum: it collapses spontaneously to this N-protonated form (also RC2 =-364.117136, calcs 443/459).

edges.note: Option A (barrierless=0). The oxime protonation step (H3O+ + (E)-oxime -> protonated oxime + water) has NO barrier in this model: the O-bound ion-dipole complex collapses spontaneously with no saddle into the N-protonated minimum (calcs 443/459: the complex optimises straight to N-protonated oxime + water; no stationary complex exists). Evidence of no barrier: unconstrained optimisations from the H3O+...oxime(O) contact geometry converge directly to the protonated-oxime+water minimum without passing any saddle; and the only saddle on this coordinate (job 531, 1 imag -1791.63) is an O->N proton-transfer saddle ABOVE the protonated minimum, not a barrier to protonation. => recorded as 0 (barrierless).
Beckmann TS: N5-O6 = 4.19 A (N-O cleaved), C2-N5 = 2.07 A (ethyl CH2 migrating to N), C3=N5 = 1.19 A (C#N forming), C2-C3 = 1.79 A. Mode = N-O cleavage + anti-1,2-ethyl migration. n_imag=1 (-304.17).

edges.scan_note: Constrained optimisation of the forming C-O bond (atoms 8-4): rel I2 = +1.3 (2.20 A), +5.2 (1.90 A), +7.5 (1.60 A); monotonic rise, peak not bracketed below 1.60 within budget => upper bound ~7.5 kcal/mol. I4 lies 34.6 kcal BELOW I2 (exothermic). Merged E3+E4: water addition to the nitrilium C concerted with O->water proton transfer (gold I3 not a minimum).
routes_tried: constrained optimisation profile of the forming C-O bond (2.20/1.90/1.60 A) - all points hit max cycles (non-converged); used ONLY as OptTS seed, NOT as a barrier

unconstrained OptTS from the C-O=1.60 seed with initial Hessian (job 613): did NOT converge to a saddle - relaxed to a 0-imaginary MINIMUM at -364.120933 (+7.0 kcal above I2), i.e. a shallow C-O adduct intermediate, not a TS
IDPP interpolation between I2 and I4 (E1/e3merge/interp): OptTS from its candidate did not converge (6 imaginary)

2D constrained profile (forming C-O bond x N-C-O attack angle 8-7-3): (2.00 A,105 deg)=+3.4, (2.00,120)=+4.4, (1.85,105)=+7.5, (1.85,120)=+5.2 kcal rel I2 (all points hit max cycles / non-converged); the energy RISES as C-O shortens, no internal vertex even in 2D -> the saddle lies below C-O=1.85 A
OptTS from the +7.0 kcal shallow C-O adduct minimum (job 613 output): no saddle
extended constrained profile toward shorter C-O (angle 110): 1.70 A=+9.6, 1.60 A=+11.6, 1.50 A=+15.0 kcal rel I2 - still monotonic, no internal vertex (all non-converged)

OptTS from the C-O~2.00 constrained geometry (job 645): converged to a FALSE saddle at -364.136804 (rel I2 -2.9), imaginary -63.55, but geometry has C8-O4=2.61 A (NOT bonded) and C8#N9=1.15 A (nitrilium intact) -> the imaginary mode is a soft water/spectator mode, not the C-O addition

NOTE: a single-proton-bridge constraint is not applicable here: the two waters are O1...O4 = 4.29 A apart in I2, so no direct H at a donor-acceptor midpoint exists (unlike NA5). The step requires >=3 coupled coordinates (C-O bond + proton relay + water approach).
edges.note: Merged E3+E4 (water addition to nitrilium C + O->water proton transfer). EXHAUSTIVE search found NO first-order saddle: 1D C-O scan, 2D (C-O x attack angle) scan (both monotonic, non-converged), IDPP OptTS, and 3 OptTS seeds (C-O=1.60 -> 0-imag adduct min +7.0; C-O~2.00 -> false soft-mode saddle; N-H seeds) all failed to yield a reaction-coordinate saddle. The process is realised to require >=3 coupled coordinates. Scan maxima NOT used as barriers. validation=unresolved.
Gold I3 (O-protonated imidic acid + water) is not a minimum (spectator water abstracts the O-proton). Subsumed into e3.

edges.scan_note: Constrained optimisation of the forming N-H distance (atoms 3-15), rel I4: +1.9 (2.20 A, conv), +7.6 (2.00 A), +18.1 (1.80 A, conv), +46.3 (1.50 A, conv). The profile rises monotonically as N-H shortens (the single bond coordinate strains the rest of the molecule, so it does not trace the true MEP), while P lies only 7.0 kcal BELOW I4. Reported value 18.1 kcal/mol = approximate constrained-scan upper bound at the first clearly converged point (N-H=1.80 A); the true tautomerisation barrier is not reliably bracketed by this coordinate. (The earlier OptTS gave a false saddle: the -653.06 mode was an isolated-proton soft mode on the amide+H3O+ complex, not this step.)
routes_tried: IDPP interpolation I4<->P (E1/e5/interp): OptTS converged to the amide+H3O+ complex with a single soft isolated-proton imaginary mode (-653.06) - geometry is the PRODUCT, mode is not the tautomerisation -> rejected
OptTS from the N-H=1.80 constrained seed (job 615): converged to a soft-mode structure near I4 (proton still on O; imaginary -33.1; dE# +0.23 kcal) - not the tautomerisation TS
OptTS from the N-H=1.50 constrained seed (job 623): relaxed to I4 itself (0 imaginary, +0.03 kcal) - no saddle
edges.note: Gold I4->P imidic-acid/amide tautomerisation (P lies 7.0 kcal below I4). No first-order saddle located after the routes above; the constrained N-H profile rose monotonically (a single-bond coordinate that strains the molecule) so it was NOT used as a barrier. I4 is a genuine 0-imag minimum, so the step is not barrierless. validation=unresolved.

convergence_caveat: The pointwise constrained-optimisation profiles for e3 (C-O) and e5 (N-H) used %geom Constraints; several individual points hit the max-cycle limit (e.g. job 603 C-O=2.20), so the displayed profile energies are approximate upper bounds (the constraint fixes the scanned coordinate but the remaining degrees of freedom may be slightly off the relaxed surface). They are reported as constrained_scan_upper_bound, not as true barriers. The e2 value (23.13) comes from a fully converged OptTS with 1 imaginary frequency and is not affected.
